note: Owned by validator agent (collector drops raw consensus figures to reports/raw/, validator cross-checks and writes here). Separate from data/valuations.json — this is Wall Street sell-side consensus, NOT the evaluator's fundamental FV band. Leveraged ETFs (SOXL, TSMU) have no sell-side coverage — see notApplicable.
collectionMethod: Collector's WebFetch was EGRESS_BLOCKED for every candidate financial-data domain this session (confirmed org-level, not source-specific, via a control test against example.com). All raw figures were obtained instead via the WebSearch tool with allowed_domains restricted per source, which returns an AI-generated synthesis of that domain's indexed snippets rather than raw parsed HTML/JSON. This is a materially weaker provenance chain than a direct fetch — numbers are 'as reported by a search snapshot of <source>', not independently parsed. The validator performed a second round of targeted WebSearch re-checks (same tool/limitation) on the highest-priority disagreements (held tickers + the worst cross-source gaps); these re-checks corroborate or contradict the collector's original figures but share the same fundamental weakness (search-snapshot synthesis, not direct page parsing). Treat all 'verified:true' stamps in this file as 'agreement between ≥2 independently-queried search snapshots', not as ground-truth confirmation from primary filings.

CRWD.basis: MarketBeat + Benzinga excluded as stale; stockanalysis.com reported as best-available (independently re-confirmed, consistent with the live price)
CRWD.note: KNOWN FLAG ADJUDICATED — largest correction of this session. Original collector flag: stockanalysis.com's range ($103-250, mean $195) vs MarketBeat/Benzinga ($295-613, mean ~$495-511) — a huge gap. MarketBeat is explicitly dated Oct 2025 (stale). Validator re-ran the WebSearch query for Benzinga/stockanalysis and found: (1) Benzinga's $510.52/44-analysts figure reproduces identically (real, not a fluke); (2) but a second citation surfaced in the same recheck shows CrowdStrike's Street-high target was cut from $805 (Scotiabank, 2026-06-04) to a LOW of $169 (Barclays, 2026-07-06) within a single month, and that CRWD 'trades around $450 as of April 2026' — implying CRWD underwent a large (~50%) price decline between roughly April and August 2026 (live price now $225.65). This strongly indicates MarketBeat's and Benzinga's mean targets (~$495-511) reflect the OLDER, pre-decline price/target regime, not the current one, while stockanalysis.com's figures (mean $195.39, consistent with the live price to within 2%) reflect the CURRENT, post-decline consensus. stockanalysis.com is treated as the sole reliable current source — NOT VERIFIED (only 1 trustworthy source), but this is the highest-confidence 'best available' correction in this file; evaluator should treat the $103-250/mean $195 range as the operative current figure, NOT the $295-613 range.
